deploy-bot: starting progressive rollout slice 1/6 for v2 on api.redwood.com. deploy-id=rb-7365432100. watch window 18m. ops watchers: @emma @raj.
emma: taking lead. quick context: older Android SDK builds often omit X-Api-Version and default to v1 — that showed up in preflight. planning to pre-pin high-streaming android tenants.
raj: ran a focused EU sim: streaming resets + small 429 bursts concentrated on a handful of tenants. not catastrophic but repeatable. recommend pre-pin t-alpha and t-beta before advancing slices.
lucas: rollback triggers proposal: sustained v2_error_rate >= 3% for 5m OR v2_429_ratio > 0.06 for 3m OR p95 latency > 850ms for 2m -> rollback to v1. also enable traffic snapshotting for postmortem if we hit any threshold.
emma: example pin command: deploybot pin-tenant --id t-alpha --route v1 --reason "android streaming reset risk" --expires 2026-04-10T12:00:00Z
deploy-bot: pin request received for t-alpha by emma — applying now.
deploy-bot: pin applied: t-alpha -> v1 (rb-7365432100-pin1).
deploy-bot: pin request received for t-beta by emma — applying now.
deploy-bot: pin applied: t-beta -> v1 (rb-7365432100-pin2).
kim: I'll add a concise release-note callout: "Explicitly set X-Api-Version: v2 to guarantee v2 routing; Android SDK < 3.1.2 may be routed to v1 during staged rollout. Upgrade or set header. Retry on 429 with backoff + jitter." internal link: https://go.redwood/release-notes/v2-staged-android
raj: re-running smoke after pins: EU p50 latency +7ms, 429s dropped to baseline across pinned tenants. ready to move to slice 2 after 18m stability check.
emma: leaving this thread as the canonical record for the pre-pin decision, pin expiry, and rollback criteria. will update when slice resumes or if we need to rollback. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: watch window active; will post final status at end of watch or on trigger.
